## Thank you for your interest in TestTalon

We are not accepting external source-code pull requests at this stage, and pull requests are not merged into this repository. This repository is generated from TestTalon's private source repository at each release.

Please open an issue instead to report a bug, request a feature, give documentation feedback or start a discussion. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details. A pull request opened here will be closed with a short note.
